system: Seven diatonic 3NPS patterns: start on each degree of low E; on each next string play the first three diatonic notes STRICTLY above the prior string's final pitch. This produces standard ascending 3NPS geometry without nearest-fret heuristic.
tuning: E2 A2 D3 G3 B3 E4

audit.method: independent strict-ascending pitch sequence, 3 notes per string, seven low E starting degrees
audit.externalComparison: C major 3NPS seven positional ranges cross-checked against Guitar Theory Studio; conventional pattern sequencing cross-checked with Fretjam and MuseScore
audit.limits: Full pixel-by-pixel diagram comparisons across all 588 patterns have not been independently performed.
